annotations: Northern Virginia, 132 ways (about 31 mi), from the Virginia ratings recheck (thread "Recheck Virginia road ratings"). P4 at LTS 3.5: 19 ways (7.4 mi); P4 at LTS 4: 24 ways (6.9 mi); P8 at LTS 2.5: 20 ways (8.5 mi); P8 at LTS 3.5: 8 ways (1.6 mi); R2 at LTS 1.5: 61 ways (6.2 mi). P4 and P8 are two-lane Fairfax County streets the county posts at 35 mph that OpenStreetMap carries no speed for; a way along several count blocks takes the busiest. R2 is Arlington's calmest uncounted residential streets. P3 and P6 (county-posted 25 mph streets) were withdrawn the same day by the owner ("Let the formula decide") once Virginia's urban default became 25 mph. Left out: ways the reviewed blocks cover less than half of; P4 and P8 ways OSM tags with a speed limit (the mapped sign is not overruled here), one-way, or with other than two lanes; and points where the road panel found an unnamed or differently named way, another rating than the review saw, or a bike lane.
